Any problem, please contact customer service, we will respond the first time.


Note: This product does not support dimming with a dimmer switch.
(Dimmable with remote)The dimming options are also limited to Dimming with a remote control.
The light has a memory function.

If you turn on the light for more than 10 seconds
and then turn it off for more than 10 seconds,

the light will remain the same color next time you turn it on.
